_about: Crafting recipes (D106, D107). Each: id (never change it once used), name, category (for the list), seconds (how long it takes: the world goes on meanwhile, and getting hurt interrupts it; nothing is used up until it's done), inputs (used up: [item or tag:<tag>, count]), tools (kept: each entry a list of alternatives, an item id or tag:<tag>), outputs ([item, count]), and a line of flavour. A tag (items.json) means any item that has it: tag:clean_water is a bottle of water or of mineral water, tag:water_container anything that holds water (a saucepan, a mug, a bottle), tag:sharp a knife or scissors, tag:fire a lighter or matches. What an input leaves behind (an empty bottle) comes back by itself. D111: heat (true) means it must be made over a heat source: a burning campfire within reach, or a camping stove with a gas canister in the pack (each use may empty the canister). places: what it puts on the ground instead of into the pack ("campfire": outdoors only). leftovers (default true): false when what the inputs leave behind is already in the outputs (boiling river water gives the bottle back as a bottle of water). D112: book: the id of the book that teaches it; until you've read that book the recipe can't be made (the list shows where to learn it). No book: everyone knows it. D113: skill: the skill it trains (10 XP a make, 15 from a book recipe) and that makes it faster (skills.json).

recipes.name: Build a campfire
recipes.about: Stones in a ring, paper underneath, wood on top. Ten minutes of fire, more if you feed it. Seen from far away at night.

recipes.name: Tear a bed sheet into rags
recipes.about: Not your grandmother's linen any more.

recipes.name: Boil river water
recipes.about: A rolling boil, then back into the bottle. Safe to drink.

recipes.name: Clean bandage
recipes.about: Rags boiled with disinfectant, as good as the shop's.

recipes.name: Vodka for the wounds
recipes.about: Strong enough to clean a cut. The booklet doesn't say what else it's good for.

recipes.name: Boil rice
recipes.about: A whole pot: more filling than the dry rice.

recipes.name: Hot soup
recipes.about: Food and drink in one, and warm.

recipes.name: Herbata (a mug of tea)
recipes.about: The end of the world can wait five minutes.

recipes.name: Kartacze
recipes.about: Potato dumplings with meat, the Podlasie way. Wigraszek's are better, but Wigraszek is closed.

recipes.name: Placki ziemniaczane
recipes.about: Grated potatoes and onion, fried on whatever's left in the pan. No flour, no oil, no complaints.

recipes.name: Molotov cocktail
recipes.about: A waste of good vodka. For when throwing things is in the game.
